facts.text: Serve the snacks when Whistler hands Blade a fresh batch of garlic serum.
facts.why: In the film the serum Blade injects holds back his thirst for blood. It is not a garlic serum. Karen later works on EDTA as a replacement. Garlic is a separate vampire weakness.
facts.fix: Serve the snacks when Blade injects his serum at Whistler's safehouse.

facts.text: Blade, eat something. A man can't hunt on an empty stomach, not even half of one.
facts.why: Whistler never says this. The quote page lists his real lines and none is about eating. It is printed in quote marks as his words.
facts.fix: Some of the legends are true though.

fix_note.text: Some of the legends are true though.

vibe.verdict: Dark bar tab layout fits Blade, but the garlic serum idea is off and the menu skips the sword, the rave and the fights.
